mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_stock_doc WHERE status = 'DRAFT' AND create_by = #{userId}) AS "docDraft", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_material m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.safety_stock IS NOT NULL AND m.safety_stock > (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.material_id = m.id)) AS "belowSafety", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_batch b WHERE b.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND b.expiry_date <= #{in30} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.material_id = b.material_id AND s.batch_no = b.batch_no AND s.qty > 0)) AS "batchExpiring", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_stock_hold WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS "holdPending", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_stock_hold WHERE status = 'REJECTED') AS "holdRejected"
